parameters.query:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT MAX(cs_week_beg_dt) AS cur_wk FROM public.cs_contacts
),
wk AS (
  SELECT
    c.cs_week_beg_dt,
    c.country,
    c.l1_topic,
    SUM(c.sr_cnt)              AS sr_cnt,
    SUM(c.rsltn_cnt)           AS rsltn_cnt,
    SUM(c.rsltn_response_cnt)  AS rsltn_response_cnt,
    SUM(c.csat_sum)            AS csat_sum,
    SUM(c.csat_response_cnt)   AS csat_response_cnt
  FROM public.cs_contacts c
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE c.cs_week_beg_dt IN (b.cur_wk, b.cur_wk - 7)
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT
  wk.cs_week_beg_dt::text            AS week,
  (SELECT cur_wk FROM bounds)::text  AS cur_week,
  wk.country,
  wk.l1_topic,
  wk.sr_cnt, wk.rsltn_cnt, wk.rsltn_response_cnt, wk.csat_sum, wk.csat_response_cnt
FROM wk
ORDER BY wk.cs_week_beg_dt, wk.country, wk.l1_topic;
